svg.title: Leviathan: from the Ugaritic Lotan to Hobbes and the fossil whale
svg.desc: A five-stage timeline from the fourteenth-century BCE Ugaritic Lotan through Job 41, Psalm 74 and Isaiah 27, Hobbes in 1651 and the fossil whale Livyatan in 2010, with panels on the text and the name.
svg.text: LOTAN / JOB 41 / HOBBES / THE FOSSIL WHALE

g.text: FIVE STAGES / 五个阶段
14TH C BCE / UGARIT
Lotan, seven heads / 洛坦，七头海蛇
JOB 41 / 《约伯记》41
scales, fire, smoke / 鳞甲、火、烟
PSALM 74 / ISAIAH 27
God crushes the serpent / 上帝砸碎海蛇
1651 / HOBBES
the state as a giant / 国家作为巨人
2010 / LIVYATAN
a fossil sperm whale / 化石抹香鲸
THE TEXT / 文本
Job 41: scales and fire / 《约伯记》41：鳞甲与火
Isaiah 27:1 / 《以赛亚书》27:1
a chaos monster / 混沌的怪物
no fossil, no specimen / 没有化石，没有标本
THE NAME / 名字
Lotan becomes Leviathan / 洛坦变成利维坦
crocodile or whale? / 鳄鱼还是鲸？
Hobbes, 1651 / 霍布斯，1651
Livyatan melvillei, 2010 / 利维坦鲸，2010
a name, not a species / 是名字，不是物种
The same sea monster served different gods and different arguments.
同一头海怪，服务过不同的神，也服务过不同的论证。
Leviathan is a text and an image, not a zoological specimen. / 利维坦是文本与图像，不是动物标本。
